description: Source code for a HoverHUDController class managing a hover-based Heads-Up Display (HUD) overlay in a macOS application. It handles visibility, hover interactions, window presentation, and dismissal of the overlay, along with a SwiftUI view for the HUD content.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A final class managing a hover-activated HUD overlay, handling user interactions and window animations.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets the suppression state, cancels ongoing show-dismiss tasks, and dismisses overlay if suppressed.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state change over the status item and manages delayed display of HUD.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Updates hover state over the panel and triggers dismiss if hover ends.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the chat panel relative to the anchor provider.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay with optional reason, cancels tasks, and executes dismissal animations.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules a delayed dismiss based on hover exit.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Prepares and presents the HUD window with animation.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the overlay window (NSPanel) if it doesn't exist, with hosting view.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for the overlay based on anchor point or default positioning.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window position and size, optionally animated.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Adds global mouse event monitor to detect outside clicks for dismissing overlay.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes the global dismiss event monitor.
